title: Lubricant R&D application (field / machine) validation record
description: Application object (WP-05). Records whether a formula+process demonstrated under a fixed process window meets the application acceptance criteria. `result` is narrowed from the common free-text result to a controlled verdict (PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE / GAP). Fail-Closed, encoded in if/then: a PASS verdict requires at least one acceptance criterion that carries a numeric threshold with OBSERVED status, a life_claim_boundary whose status is OBSERVED with at least one validated condition, and no counterexamples. A criterion whose threshold is not determined must be recorded with status GAP (never silently omitted); an empty acceptance_criteria list forces result GAP. This never asserts a physical, commercial, or life conclusion on its own.

formula_reference.description: The formulation / design under test this application record belongs to.

process_window_reference.description: The fixed process window this application was demonstrated under, as PROCESS-WINDOW:<window_id> (process.schema.json process_window.evidence_reference), never a free-form record.

bench_references.description: Bench ids (bench.schema.json bench_id) that produced this record. Consumed by WP-06 stage=APPLIED evidence aggregation.

acceptance_criteria.description: Acceptance criteria for the application. May be empty, but then result must be GAP; a criterion with no determined threshold must carry status GAP.

result.description: Controlled verdict (narrows the common artifact result to an enum). PASS is only reachable with determined, OBSERVED criteria and a non-empty life_claim_boundary.

counterexamples.description: Observed counterexamples to the acceptance criteria. Any entry blocks a PASS verdict.

life_claim_boundary.description: Boundary of the life/durability claim this record supports. Empty (no validated_conditions, or status GAP) can never support a PASS verdict.

acceptance_criterion.description: One acceptance criterion. A criterion whose threshold is not determined must declare status GAP; a determined threshold must declare status OBSERVED or ASSUMED and carry operator/unit/source/evidence_id.

life_claim_boundary.description: The conditions under which the stated life/durability claim holds, plus its extrapolation basis. An empty validated_conditions list is an explicit 'no validated boundary'.

observed_life_claim_boundary.description: life_claim_boundary strengthened for a PASS verdict: status OBSERVED with at least one validated condition.
